title: Tenant maintenance request form for commercial buildings
description: A free template for reporting routine HVAC, lighting or plumbing issues in a commercial building. Record the exact location, what you noticed and when staff can check it.
intro: Download or print this form, fill it in and send it through your building’s approved maintenance channel. For site access, give the available time and escort arrangements.
emergency: For a fire or immediate hazard, follow the building’s emergency procedures and use its designated emergency contacts.
exampleNote: This example uses a fictional shared meeting room where the cooling is insufficient.
nextTitle: Hand an open request to the next shift
nextText: Facilities staff can record the request reference, assigned team and next check. Use the same reference at shift handover so the incoming team can find the exact location and current status.
pilot: Open the facilities AI pilot checklist
